research_caveat: IMPORTANT: NO Pylon primary source could be consulted in this session at all. Two independent environment failures: (1) the sandbox network gateway (agent proxy) returned 403 CONNECT denials — an organization egress-policy block, per /root/.ccr/README.md 'do not retry or route around it' — for every Pylon host attempted via both WebFetch and curl: https://usepylon.com/security, https://usepylon.com/privacy, https://www.usepylon.com/security, https://trust.usepylon.com/, https://docs.usepylon.com/ (security.usepylon.com does not resolve); web.archive.org was also unreachable, so no archived copy could be read either. This is the same environment condition documented in deepgram.json, daily.json, mux.json, and cerebras.json (those hosts appear in the proxy's recentRelayFailures log alongside these). (2) Unlike those sibling vendors, this session ALSO had zero web-search budget remaining (200/200 WebSearch calls already consumed before the first Pylon query), so not even domain-restricted search snippets of Pylon's own pages were available. Per the researcher hard rules (never infer from training data or industry norms; a value requires a URL fetched in THIS session), every Bucket A field below is 'Not known' with confidence 'none'. This says nothing about Pylon's actual documentation, which may well be thorough — a verifier or human re-run from an unrestricted network should visit usepylon.com (security/trust/privacy/DPA pages) FIRST and will likely be able to fill most fields before falling back to the written vendor questions. The trade name 'Pylon' and role 'Customer support platform' come from config/scope.yaml (Tavus's authorized-subprocessor list), not from vendor research.

open_questions_for_vendor: Please confirm the full legal name and legal form of the Pylon entity that contracts with Tavus for the customer support platform (e.g. '..., Inc.', state/country of incorporation), and confirm it matches the entity named in your DPA signature block.

Please provide your registered/principal business address, and state whether you have designated a representative in the EU under Article 27 GDPR (if yes: representative's name and full address; if no: your position on why Art. 27 does not apply).

Have you formally appointed a Data Protection Officer? If yes, please provide the DPO's name, telephone number and/or email address. If no, please provide the email address and/or telephone number of a contact entitled to respond to data-protection requests.

Which security certifications and audit reports do you currently hold (SOC 2 Type I/II — auditor and period covered, SOC 1/3, ISO 27001, ISO 27018, ISO 27701, ISO 9001, ISO 22301)? Please provide the current SOC 2 Type II report and/or certificates with scope statements under NDA so Tavus can place them on file.
What minimum TLS version is enforced for data in transit to your application and APIs (TLS 1.2 or TLS 1.3 floor)?
Which encryption standard is used for data at rest (e.g. AES-256), and does it cover all customer data including support-conversation content and attachments?
Are backups encrypted, and with which algorithm?
Who generates and manages the encryption keys (platform-managed KMS — which provider; customer-specific keys; any CMEK/BYOK option)?

Can Pylon, acting as a processor, anonymize and/or pseudonymize personal data stored in the platform (contact records, support conversations) on customer instruction — e.g. redaction or deletion/anonymization workflows?

Please list your other technical safeguards: SSO/SAML and MFA support, role-based access control, audit logging, penetration testing cadence, vulnerability management, and your underlying hosting/cloud provider(s).
Do you offer an EU hosting region or EU data-residency option for customer data? If yes, which cloud provider and region(s), and does it cover processing, storage, and backups?

Please provide your current sub-processor list for the service (SAP requires the processing chain to Level 2, e.g. the cloud provider hosting your platform and any AI/LLM sub-processors used on support-conversation content).
